annotations.title: Estimate order sales lost to missed calls

description: Use only when the user supplies their own call volume and asks what missed phone calls may cost a restaurant. Runs the same model as the maple.inc ROI calculator on the numbers given: calls per day, the share missed and average order value, plus optional assumptions that otherwise use the calculator's illustrative defaults. Returns an illustrative estimate of order sales from missed calls with every assumption shown. It is a scenario, not a measured result or a guarantee, and it leaves out reservations and catering. Read-only arithmetic.

averageOrderValue.description: Average phone order value in dollars.

capturedOrderPercent.description: Share of those order requests that would become completed orders. Default 50.

missedCallPercent.description: Share of calls that go unanswered, 0-100.

orderCallPercent.description: Share of missed calls that were order requests. Default 50.
